reviewContext.userProblem: Explicit bounded directory writePaths fail after the first fanout dependency wave, and reduce cannot observe newly created or removed directory descendants.
requiredOutcomes: Capture safe bounded directory roots and their membership at each node boundary.
Re-enumerate declared roots at reduce and report added, removed, replaced, membership, content and mode drift with path and branch attribution.
Verify two dependency waves and a deterministic 60-path/407-file scale fixture.
nonGoals: Scheduler or schema changes, cross-wave actor state, filesystem watchers or atomic snapshots.
Registry discovery, package changes, release, merge or sibling worktree writes.
constraints: Keep source changes in WorkflowFanoutChangeEvidence.swift and focused tests in WorkflowFanoutMapReduceTests.swift.
Reject traversal, Git metadata, symlinks, special or unreadable entries; never silently skip unsafe entries.
Enforce 1 to 512 declared paths, at most 512 unique expanded entries, 8,000,000 bytes per file and 64,000,000 aggregate bytes at capture and reduce.
Keep scratch and complete verification logs under tmp/issue-118; use per-plan and per-attempt subdirectories; record terminal exit codes.
Workers do not stage, commit or push; serial reconciliation and independent review precede final commit and non-force push.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Retain declared roots with each immutable evidence record so reduce can discover descendants absent at capture.
Use deterministic sorted directory entries and immediate child lists to expose membership drift without adding a watcher.
Keep collector, reducer and tests in one serial plan because they share one tightly coupled source contract.
intentionalTradeoffs: Node-boundary snapshots can miss transient writes within an agent invocation.
The reported package plan is represented by a deterministic scale fixture because its original manifest was not supplied.
supportedEdgeCases: Hidden and empty directories, overlapping roots, missing-root creation, file/directory replacement and directory removal.
New and removed descendants, mode and byte drift, dangling or ancestor symlinks, concurrent mutation and inclusive or exceeded limits.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Atomic filesystem consistency and crash recovery across external edits.
Replay of the original 60-path/407-file package plan without its manifest.
reviewContext.reviewDecision: Step 3 design and Step 5 plan accepted without findings; T1 through T4 proceed serially, followed by reconciliation and independent review.

acceptanceCriteria: Directory capture and reduce preserve exact-file behavior, safety bounds and immutable evidence while exposing membership drift.
Focused tests pass for dependency waves, directory and missing-root transitions, unsafe entries, races, limits and the 60-path/407-file fixture.
Self-review and all required source gates pass with complete logs and terminal exit codes in the plan progress file.
